title: Postmortem: gallery memory leak
text: The memory leak was caused by the image cache holding strong references to view controllers through a closure. When the user scrolled through the gallery, each cell registered a callback that captured self, so none of the controllers were ever released. Switching to a weak reference fixed it, and memory now stays flat at around 180 MB.
